about: The crossing (docs/milestones/crypt-rework.md, CR6): a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones hanging in the dark, its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall); its four sarcophagi the room's own walls, drawn in its scene. In the middle, inside the ring of four pillars, the floor has fallen in: a round pit (crypt_pit), ringed by floor and small enough to dash over, two cracks running out of it between the pillars; bays where the slab runs out; the floor pushed out round every spawn, gate, pillar and decal. tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_04_ground.tscn and its art from this.
